rationale: No supported optimization can be applied safely while preserving intended coverage. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) is contraindicated: the integration-tests matrix splits the Cypress suite across 5 workers (WORKER_NUM 0-4 of WORKER_COUNT 5), so every matrix outcome is required for full integration coverage; canceling the rest on one failure would lose test results, matching the pattern's 'Every matrix outcome is required' contraindication. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative per-job duration history (the CI history has sparse/unreliable timestamps and no job-level timings), and the evidence's 5-minute timeout is inappropriate for build/test jobs that run around 10+ minutes, so a custom timeout risks failing valid slow or cold-cache runs ('Valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit'). P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency caching cannot be verified: the .github/actions/setup-project action contents are unavailable, so I cannot confirm installation behavior, cache inputs (lockfile/environment), or avoid redundancy with the existing .eslintcache in the lint job. Applying any of these would either reduce coverage or introduce unverified risk, and no privileged actions, secrets, publishing, or new network access are added.
